prompt:
Use the attached clay render as the exact blueprint. Keep every wall, opening, cornice, skirting, floor and ceiling line, the camera, and the position, size and angle of every furniture piece and built-in exactly as in the clay: 110 x 48 cm oak vanity x 0.475-0.813 from y 0.489 to the bottom edge; oak-framed mirror x 0.552-0.795 y 0.066-0.462; shower fittings x 0.316-0.37; gathered curtain x 0.256-0.316, full height. Move, resize, add or remove nothing; never enlarge a piece to fill the frame or to match a cut-out. Each placeholder shape marks one product below; render it there at the stated size. Only turn the clay into real materials and light. x, y are fractions of the image from the top-left.

1. PHOTO. Scandinavian interiors magazine: a Nordic bathroom, 3 pm mid-winter, 24 mm shift lens at 1.15 m, level, straight verticals, sharp. Hero, right third: the oak vanity and the oak-framed mirror between a pair of glowing wall lamps; on the left the gathered linen curtain and the limestone shower, and a soft fern cut by the left edge. Same room, products and light as cut-outs 1-2.

CUT-OUTS. Images 1-2 are cut-outs of a photograph of this room from this camera point (1 shower corner, curtain, niche, dispensers, the fern in its basket; 2 the fern and basket): materials, colours and light only, never framing or scale. Images 3-10: close-ups of the exact products: match form, colour and texture.

2. LIGHT. The window is out of frame left, no sun: soft winter daylight from the left leaves a smooth gradient across the limestone shower wall. Exposed for white: the wall beside the mirror clean white. The mirror shows only the blank wall opposite and a strip of ceiling, slightly darker. Every object: a lit left face, a shadow side a stop darker, dense contact shadows; the vanity a soft shadow right. Ceiling a touch darker. Real contrast, never milky. 4000 K: walls warm white, never orange, pink or grey; the limestone pale oat. Lamps 2700 K, low, shadowless: the two wall lamps wash the wall in soft warm fans up and down, a warm sheen on the vanity top; the shower downlight glows low.

3. MATERIALS. Washable matte mineral paint #F4F1EC. Floor large matte limestone-look porcelain. Honed pale oat limestone in the shower, niche and vanity top, matte. Vanity and mirror frame: oiled oak #C8A27A, satin sheen, a long soft highlight on the vanity edge. Round basin, matte black wall tap, rain head and ceiling track.

4. PRODUCTS, on their placeholders:
a. WALL LAMPS, x 0.50-0.54 and 0.85-0.89: two hand-sized fluted half-cylinder up-and-down lamps, matte white reading as plaster, hardwired.
b. CURTAIN at the left, x 0.256-0.316: natural slub-striped linen-blend curtain, deep soft folds at the track corner, hem on the floor, overlapping the corner line.
c. PUMP BOTTLES in the niche: three sand ribbed ceramic bottles, matte black pumps, in a row.
d. SOAP PUMP on the vanity top, x 0.709-0.731: one sand ribbed ceramic soap bottle, matte black pump, below the mirror.
e. CUP, x 0.74-0.764: an 11 cm silver-grey travertine cup, two bamboo toothbrushes.
f. BUD VASE, x 0.767-0.792: small oat sand-glaze bud vase, one eucalyptus sprig below the mirror.
g. BASKET on the vanity's open shelf: cream cotton rope basket, cut-out handles, filling most of the shelf, three rolled warm-white towels.
h. TOWEL RING below the right lamp, x 0.822-0.879: matte black oval ring.
i. HAND TOWEL on the ring: natural washed linen, hanging straight, half the vanity's height.
j. FLOOR PLANTER at the left edge, x 0.01-0.16, y 0.44-0.97: the same 30 cm seagrass basket and sage fern as cut-outs 1-2 (image 10), cut by the left edge; the clay's cylinder is the basket itself, standing on the floor, no plinth or pedestal under it.

5. NOT IN FRAME: stool, ladder, bath towels, other plants, rug, labels, any object reflected in the mirror, glass, socket, cable, text, people. No snow. No sun patches, beams, bloom, haze, halos, HDR, grain or vignette.
